title: Kaushal Kishore v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amitava Lala, J.; Vinay Kumar Mathur, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; apply to Superintending Engineer for consideration.
headnote: A writ seeking a Sukh Rahat Package tubewell connection, the licensee having treated the dispute as load reduction under clause 4.41 of the Supply Code, 2005, is not decided on the writ side; the consumer is to apply to the Superintending Engineer for consideration.
facts: Kaushal Kishore petitioned the Allahabad High Court that the Executive Engineer had not given him a tubewell connection under the Sukh Rahat Package. The licensee treated the controversy as load reduction, said to be covered by sub-clause (f)(ii) of clause 4.41 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for both sides were heard at the admission stage.

holding_units.topic: tubewell connection / load reduction — writ vs Superintending Engineer
holding_units.holding: A writ against the Executive Engineer's refusal of a Sukh Rahat Package tubewell connection, the licensee having treated the matter as load reduction under sub-clause (f)(ii) of clause 4.41, cannot be resolved on the writ side. The consumer is to apply to the Superintending Engineer within seven days of the certified copy; the Superintending Engineer is to consider the cause as early as possible and within one month of the application.
holding_units.flag: clause recited as Sub-Clause f (ii) under Clause 4.41; numbering as in the order

not_decided.point: Entitlement to a tubewell connection under the Sukh Rahat Package
not_decided.note: Merits of the Executive Engineer's refusal left to the Superintending Engineer.

not_decided.point: Whether the dispute is covered by clause 4.41(f)(ii) as load reduction
not_decided.note: The court recorded the licensee's position but did not decide it.
